verdict.rationale: Column's docs confirm both check issuance and deposit via API (column-docs-4), but no evidence describes image-capture mechanics for deposits, and a Column engineer notes checks were 'currently in beta' at time of comment (column-comm-2), indicating limited maturity rather than a fully proven feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation of image-capture/deposit workflow details, confirmation that check functionality has exited beta, and independent hands-on verification of check deposit reliability.
